judgment.defect_reason: The supplied prompt and working notes say Purchase alone approves price changes. The in-force record-17 (revision 2, approved) requires Finance, Program Managers and Purchase. The registry resolves this conflict, so the rubric is fair and the task is not ambiguous.
judgment.rationale: The submission applies the approved three-way approval for price changes (Finance controllers, Program Managers, Purchase) and explicitly rejects the unapproved revision 3 draft. It retains the TRSO sign-off by ER, Quality and Purchase at Gate 1 and the nomination sign-off by Finance, Quality, ER and Program Manager at Gate 5. It includes modular cost drivers across features, design elements, child parts and raw material, plus versioning (a versioned module library, versioned baseline and numbered change requests) and an immutable audit log with e-signatures. For late changes it offers tiers, a delta approach, parallel review and provisional release, and it keeps all mandatory gates in place. Assumptions and open points are stated, and the benefit claim is flagged as an unvalidated target. The one caveat is that Tier 1 rate-only changes still need all three approvals, which is conservative but consistent with the rule. No substantive repair is needed.
